description: BM25 search over all 663 live AINumbers ChainGraph node tools. Returns ranked tools with mcp_name, URL, mandate type, and wave. Use to locate a specific computation node (e.g. "FRTB expected shortfall", "MiCA own funds", "XVA calculator", "reserve composition", "2052a", "initial margin", "model validation benchmark", "TVM / damages calculator") before calling it. Complements find_chain (chain-level) and list_ainumbers_tools (catalog-level).
